// Vendored FFX API headers for the Vulkan upscale context (`vk_upscaler_ffxapi.cpp`).
// Upstream: https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK tag v1.1.4
// (commit c6efa6bf7f2027b3ec94f28578bb5965eabb9e55). From `ffx-api/include/ffx_api/` below: the
// C headers the backend compiles against (`ffx_api.h`, `ffx_api_types.h`, `ffx_upscale.h`,
// `vk/ffx_api_vk.h`, plus the C++ helpers `ffx_api.hpp`/`ffx_upscale.hpp`). AMD's SDK license

// `libamd_fidelityfx_vk.so`) is the user's own, loaded at run time; never shipped here.
